# FR-001: Verify checksums on artifact import

## Description

When an artifact is imported, the importer SHALL verify its checksum.

## Acceptance Criteria

| ID | Criteria | Verification |
|----|----------|--------------|
| FR-001-AC-1 | A mismatching checksum rejects the import. | Test (TC-001) |

## Dependencies

- None.
